# Flat White Living

> Interior design and project management studio based in The Hague, the Netherlands, run by Elisa Vives. Works throughout the Netherlands and internationally, with a focus on international clients.

## Pages
- [Interior Designer in The Hague & the Netherlands](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/): Bespoke interior design, architecture, project management and styling for homes and international clients in the Netherlands. Based in The Hague.
- [About](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/about.html): Meet the designer behind Flat White Living, an interior design studio in The Hague working with international clients across the Netherlands.
- [Contact](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/contact.html): Start your interior design project. Get in touch with Flat White Living in The Hague.
- [How It Works](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/how-it-works.html): From the first brief and design concept to sourcing, installation and final styling: how an interior design project with Flat White Living works.
- [Interior Design for International Clients in the Netherlands](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/international-clients.html): One point of contact for expats and international clients: suppliers, contractors and decisions handled locally in the Netherlands.
- [Journal](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/journal.html): Notes on interiors, materials and living well in Dutch homes, from Flat White Living in The Hague.
- [Interior Design Projects](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/projects.html): Selected residential interior design projects in The Hague and Rotterdam.
- [Interior Design Services](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/services.html): Interior design, architecture, project management, styling and property staging in The Hague and throughout the Netherlands.

## Projects
- [A Three-Storey Family Townhouse in The Hague](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-family-townhouse-the-hague.html): Interior design of a three-storey family townhouse in The Hague: a reconfigured ground floor, a master suite with walk-in wardrobe and en-suite, and children's rooms with bespoke storage.
- [A Refined City Retreat in Rotterdam](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-flat-rotterdam-city-centre.html): Complete renovation of a city-centre apartment in Rotterdam: a new kitchen, a walk-in shower, floor-to-ceiling oak joinery and a calm white, black and stone palette.
- [A Natural Coastal Home](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-oak-kitchen-family-home.html): Complete renovation of a 1950s beach house: small rooms opened into one light-filled ground floor around an oak kitchen, with natural materials and colours drawn from the coast.
- [A Refined Family Home in The Hague](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-refined-family-home-the-hague.html): Kitchen and bathroom design for a family home in The Hague: floor-to-ceiling kitchen storage, and a bathroom with shower, bath, plant shelf and integrated laundry.
- [A Softer Expression of Grandeur](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-family-home-visserijbuurt-the-hague.html): Furnishing refresh of a grand family home in the Visserijbuurt, The Hague: lounge chairs, mirrored side tables, an arc lamp and velvet curtains bring warmth to high-ceilinged rooms.
- [A Calm Bedroom Retreat in The Hague](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-bedroom-renovation-the-hague.html): Bedroom renovation in The Hague: two rooms joined into one, with bespoke floor-to-ceiling wardrobes, a blue panelled wall, brass details and full-height doors to the garden.
- [A More Connected Family Home in Statenkwartier](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-family-home-statenkwartier-the-hague.html): Kitchen and bathroom renovation of a family home in Statenkwartier, The Hague: a new peninsula, floor-to-ceiling storage and a warm, calming master bathroom.
